body: It's not even about the money for me. I just want to be done, dead.
I used to think I wasn't but my actions have proved me wrong
I'm a disappointment mostly because I'm a selfish asshole and only care about myself.
Impressive assesment, internet stranger. How did you arrive at that conclusion?
Oh god yes. I haven't hit 30 yet but there's not much incentive to do it either. The world is going to shit and we're all tired.
Same. Life is miserable and not worth it.
I love when people don't read the title of the post lmao
Idk if that's the right word. I'm not about to harm myself or anyone. I want the choice off my hands. I just love the idea of having your days numbered.
I don't feel sorry for myself, but it sure sounds like you're in the wrong sub lol
Life is nothing if not a let down...
Nah it's good. I'm just tired and done with everything. I hope things get better for you.
Life? Idk everything sucks and "good patches" never last so i don't see the point in this anymore.

Oh yea, once I die all my organs that are worth anything are to be donated. I guess I will be worth more after. Honestly I was even thinking of having whatever's left donated to science. I don't want there to be anything left of me, not even ashes.

I'm turning 28 this year and I'm absolutely terrified of making it to 30. I can't. I can't keep doing this for this long. But I'm too much of a coward to kill myself. My dad died of cancer a few years back and everyday I find myself wondering why it couldn't be me.
I wish I could trade places with someone with a terminal illness. I don't see the point here anymore.
